review.scope: Entry-reachable direct CFG correspondence under the listed exact-name/import/function-address identities. Ignore architectural no-ops and direct internal jump trampolines; preserve ordinary operations, registers, operand widths, prefixes and edge predicates, including paired inverse predicates. Shared/duplicated tails may correlate to the same instructions. This is structural evidence, not execution, callee/data-content equivalence, literal pointer-identity proof or a whole-game proof. Read-only C-string and declared DIALOG-token mappings compare complete contents through NUL, not storage identity, alias relationships or bytes beyond the terminator. Arbitrary PC/return-address inspection is outside this review. Calls are followed through normal returns only; exception/unwind/longjmp edges are not covered. Indirect jumps are refused. Unsupported operation, register, address and width differences remain unresolved. Raw scores and discovery differences are unchanged; current native/rebuilt ranges are pinned.
